connector.name: AgentTrust by assister-xyz
connector.registryDescription: Quality verification for AI agents and MCP servers. 6-axis scoring, adversarial probes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-agenttrust. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the assister-xyz account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
